newsitem.title: USA: Physician Corp enters reinsurance pact.
newsitem.headline: Physician Corp enters reinsurance pact.

text.p: Physician Corp of America said Tuesday that in conjunction with its merger agreement with Humana Inc, it has entered into a reinsurance pact for its troubled workers compensation unit, PCA Property & Casualty Insurance Co.

The reinsurance pact, entered into with the Florida Department of Insurance, provides for the purchase of a reinsurance policy from Centre Reinsurance Co of New York or its equivalent, Physician Corp said.
The company said the reinsurance policy seeks to resolve its property & casualty subsidiary's financial difficulties.
Physician Corp said it will record a $4 million charge to reflect a deposit, and take an additional charge of $38 million to reflect the premium if the reinsurance policy is funded.
The effectiveness of the policy is subject to funding, the company said.
Physician Corp said it expects the Humana deal -- valued at $400 million -- to close in the third quarter, subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals.
Physician Corp provides comprehensive health care services through its health maintenance organizations in Florida, Texas and Puerto Rico.
